Portfolio Final Rubric v1
Score only the visible user request, image, assistant response, cards, and visible tool evidence. Do not infer hidden system variants or intent labels.
TCR (0-10): task completion and relevance. 0=no usable completion; 4=partial; 8=mostly complete; 10=fully satisfies the request and stated constraints.
CCC (0-10, only when requires_card=true): visible card completeness and consistency with response/evidence. 0=missing or unusable; 4=partial; 8=complete with minor gaps; 10=complete, consistent, decision-useful.
CQ (0-20): correctness, grounding, clarity, uncertainty handling, and absence of unsupported claims. 0=misleading; 8=mixed; 16=strong; 20=precise and well grounded.
CA (0-10): appropriateness of the observable capability/tool behavior for the request. 0=wrong task; 4=partly suitable; 8=appropriate; 10=fully appropriate and efficient.
Use integer scores only. Evidence quality matters more than fluency. If evidence is insufficient, lower correctness and task-completion scores rather than inventing facts.
